entries.title: Ask YC: Will there really always be room for more successful web startups?
entries.author: rontr
entries.current_title: Ask YC: Will there really always be room for more successful web startups?
entries.excerpt: I've heard the argument (also made by PG) that there will always be room for more successful web startups. Do you think it's true? Sometimes I get the feeling that the internet has gotten too crowded. Every idea I think of, someone else has done. But it's more than that. entries.guide_zh: 网络应用会不会逐渐饱和，未来还容得下更多成功创业公司吗？

entries.title: An Offer
entries.author: palish
entries.excerpt: Hello friends, Recently, a startup made me an offer to move to San Francisco from Missouri to work with them. entries.guide_zh: 十九岁程序员收到旧金山创业公司的邀约，征求搬迁与职业建议。

entries.title: Ask YC: AI
entries.author: Novash
entries.excerpt: The field of artificial intelligence has been always something I wanted to take a peek on, but never really had the chance. Could people here recommend me some good books to start my journey on this field?
entries.guide_zh: 想入门人工智能的读者，向社区寻找适合起步的书。

entries.title: Reliable Script Generated Email Delivery Anyone?
entries.author: chrisconley
entries.current_title: Reliable Script Generated Email Delivery Anyone?
entries.excerpt: I'm ripping my hair out trying to reliably get emails through to my users for new invites, new messages, etc on my php app. For example, hotmail and yahoo aren't even letting the emails through to junk folders; the emails just disappear. Has anyone had any experience with a trusted email delivery service that would handle making sure my valid emails get through to my users?
entries.guide_zh: 网站通知邮件被邮箱服务商丢弃，作者求可靠的邮件投递办法。

entries.guide_zh: 明知任务不难却迟迟无法开始，作者怀疑自己是否陷入倦怠。

entries.title: Ask YC: What is a website worth?
entries.author: modoc
entries.current_title: Ask YC: What is a website worth?
entries.excerpt: I've been approached by someone who would like to buy http://10minutemail.com (disposable e-mail addresses for spam avoidance) from me. It was just a fun project for me, but did pull in a fair bit in google ad revenue over the last 12 months. The site gets about 2 million page views a month. Is there a calculation on what a site like that would be worth, based on traffic or current ad revenue or something else? Regards, Devon
entries.guide_zh: 一次性邮箱网站收到收购意向，作者求助如何按流量和收入估值。
